references.label: Upper bumpers
references.description: The two top bumpers advance the related rocket values during upper-playfield action.

references.label: Upper gate targets
references.description: The safer upper side standups that open the swing gate on the same side.

references.label: Left and right swing gates
references.description: The side gates that open after a same-side target hit and return the ball toward a flipper.

references.label: Curved rocket lanes
references.description: The two main side scoring lanes, each with its own advancing rocket value.

references.label: Lower white rollovers
references.description: The small side rollovers that advance the related rocket value during natural passes.

references.label: Lower gate targets
references.description: The dangerous lower side standups that can rebound through the wide center drain.

references.label: Center post
references.description: The optional post above the center drain; its installed rubber and presence can vary.
